# Transfermarkt

> > The world's leading football database providing comprehensive player profiles, market values, transfer data, and career statistics for professional footballers worldwide.

Transfermarkt is the premier platform for football transfer news, player valuations, and detailed career statistics. The site covers players from top clubs like Arsenal FC, Al-Hilal SFC, Athletic Bilbao, and Lyon, featuring detailed profiles with market values, contract information, and performance data across all major leagues and competitions.

## Key Topics

- Player profiles and statistics
- Transfer market values
- Career statistics and performance data
- Arsenal FC
- Al-Hilal SFC
- Athletic Bilbao
- Lyon
- Goalkeeper positions
- Centre-forward and striker positions
- Right-winger positions
- Spanish footballers
- French footballers
- Brazilian footballers
- Contract and transfer data
- Football clubs and teams
